finding.claim: When opts.noext is true scan clears isGlob unconditionally, so patterns like "*.js" are reported as non-globs even though only extglobs should be disabled.
finding.title: scan with noext clears isGlob

finding.title: tokens last-segment check uses falsy index

finding.claim: First slash token is marked as prefix whenever start != 0, so for a negated pattern like "!foo/bar" the "foo" segment is overwritten with prefix "!" instead of only treating slashes before start as prefix.
finding.title: first tokens entry overwritten with prefix

verifier.reason: The code at scan.js:371-373 unconditionally sets tokens[0].isPrefix and tokens[0].value to prefix whenever start is non-zero, without checking whether the first slash at scan.js:368 precedes start as the parts logic does at scan.js:380.
